away.summary: The Sabres (9-9-4) head to Florida after a 5-2 loss to the Capitals. Coach Lindy Ruff indicated there could be a lineup change or two based on health, with Mattias Samuelsson back in the lineup after missing Wednesday's practice for maintenance. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is projected to start after making his first start in four games in the previous matchup.

home.summary: The Panthers (12-8-3) are dealing with significant injuries to Barkov and Marchand, both of whom have been practicing but are not expected back immediately; Barkov could return sometime next week before Marchand. Gadjovich practiced in a no-contact jersey but remains a ways from returning. Radko Gudas returns to the third defense pair as the only lineup change from Tuesday's loss to Edmonton.
